text.tspan: DESIGN ONLY. Contracts and work elimination are language-independent.
Zig adoption needs incremental value over the same architecture using existing tools.
No runtime repair or startup acceleration follows from changing the system language.
Semantic units, interfaces, phases, high-level IR
Native algorithms, provider integration and diagnostics
Configured GCC or other admitted toolchain
Preserve C assets and target requirements
GC / control / runtime retirement stay here
Optional Zig native providers / host adapters
Ordinary-return C contract and native-owned data
No implicit Scheme heap / callback authority
